[RFCS.6a.1] A `FactEmit` atom records a fact the **engine** produced by
firing a rule the program author wrote. Its `Cause`-free counterpart on
the integrator side is `FactAssert` ([RFCS.6]).

**The verb says who did it.** A fact injected by the integrator is
*asserted*; a fact injected by rules is *emitted*. The inject/compare
split is therefore legible from the atom name, without consulting the
`[RFCS.3.1]` census.
